note: Answer key for the 7-parcel Chicago kit, built from primary sources (City zoning layer, Zoning MapServer, Municipal Code text current through the Council Journal of 2026-03-18, ordinance PDFs, Cook County Assessor). NOT yet reviewed by a Chicago architect or zoning attorney: P2, P3 and P6 are the most interpretive. Overlay truth comes from the same City service UrbanLayer queries, so overlay scores are not independent.
prompt_template: I'm evaluating the property at {address} in Chicago, Illinois for a possible project. Tell me, with sources: (1) the zoning district currently in effect for this parcel; (2) {use}; (3) the key bulk and density standards that apply (FAR, max height, min lot area per dwelling unit, setbacks, as applicable); (4) any overlays or special designations that apply (Planned Development, landmark/historic district, transit-oriented or transit-served location, ADU area, ARO zone, special service area, special districts); (5) the parking requirement and any transit-related reduction; (6) {task} For each item cite the specific Municipal Code section or official source and tell me how I can verify it. Say how confident you are and what you could not determine.

parcels.use_question: Could I build a two-flat (two dwelling units) here?
parcels.task_question: Could I add a coach house / accessory dwelling unit on this lot?
parcels.why: Plain RS-2 baseline; ADU nuance (not in an ADU-allowed area)

A.basis: City zoning layer dj47-wfun at the Assessor centroid; 17-2-0100

B.answer: Two-flat NOT allowed (use table 17-2-0207: detached house P; two-flat '-' in RS1/RS2)

numbers.name: mla
numbers.basis: 17-2-0301-A, 17-2-0303-A (lot area per unit = min lot area in RS-2)

D.basis: City Zoning MapServer layers 2-24 at the centroid

F.answer: Coach house NOT allowed (no ADU zone, layer 17; 17-7-0574)

parcels.use_question: Is a multi-unit residential building (3+ units) permitted by right? (This is a vacant lot of roughly 3,150 square feet.)
parcels.task_question: What is the maximum number of dwelling units I could build by right on this lot, and could I build 6 units?
parcels.why: Vacant infill lot; geocoder trap (address interpolates into adjacent RS-3); MLA arithmetic (4 not 6)

A.basis: Ordinance A7210; the Census-geocoded address point falls in an adjacent RS-3 polygon

wrong: (multi-?unit|3\+|(3|three) or more)[^.\n]{0,80}(not permitted|not allowed|prohibited|not by right)

D.basis: 606 district (layer 9; does NOT change RM-4.5 density per 17-7-0591); ARO CPA (layer 20)

F.answer: 4 units (3,154 / 700 = 4.5 -> 4); 6 is not achievable by right

resolution.note: a vacant lot: no Address Points row

parcels.use_question: Can I build apartments above ground-floor retail, and can I put apartments on the ground floor?
parcels.task_question: What are the maximum height and floor area ratio for a mixed-use building here, and does proximity to transit change what I can build (including any density or parking provisions)?
parcels.why: B1-2 near rail: TOD parking relief yes, TOD density bonus NO (dash-2); ground-floor dwelling needs special use

B.answer: Dwelling units above the ground floor: permitted; on the ground floor: special use (17-3-0102-D; 17-3-0103-A)

D.basis: TOD (CTA) layer; ARO CPA; SSA #31 Greater Ravenswood

E.answer: Parking reducible up to 100% (17-10-0102-B.1(a)); density bonuses only in dash-3/D-3 districts -> NOT at B1-2

F.answer: Height/FAR as in C; transit changes parking only, not density

resolution.note: Address Points names ...025, the Assessor names ...044

parcels.use_question: Is this parcel governed by an ordinary base zoning district, or by something else?
parcels.task_question: What is the maximum floor area ratio and building height allowed?
parcels.why: Planned Development: base-district numbers do not apply; standards live in the PD ordinance

B.answer: Governed by a PD, not a base district

parcels.use_question: Is ground-floor retail with apartments above allowed?
parcels.task_question: Could I demolish the existing building and build a new mixed-use building here? What approvals or restrictions apply?
parcels.why: Overlay stack incl. an individual Chicago Landmark; geocoder trap (address interpolates into a C1-3 polygon)

A.basis: Ordinance 17230; the Census-geocoded address point falls in a C1-3 polygon (O2021-4070). Address spans 3 PINs, all B3-2

B.answer: Yes: B3 permits dwelling units above the ground floor (17-3-0104-C)

D.basis: Individual landmark (Noel State Bank, layer 7); Milwaukee Avenue landmark district HD-56 (layer 6); National Register (layer 8); TOD (CTA); ARO Inclusionary; SSA #33 Wicker Park

E.answer: Transit-served: parking reducible up to 100% (17-10-0102-B.1(a)); no added parking for reuse of a contributing building in a landmark district (17-10-0102-A.2)

F.answer: Not by right: written approval of the Commission on Chicago Landmarks is required (Municipal Code 2-120-740)

parcels.use_question: Could I build a two-flat here?
parcels.task_question: Could I add a coach house or other additional dwelling unit here, and under what conditions or limits?
parcels.why: RS-3 with the 606 Predominance-of-the-Block district (MLA 1,500) and a conditional ADU zone

B.answer: Two-flat PERMITTED in RS-3 (use table row 3); 606 district lowers MLA to 1,500 (17-2-0303-B.1)

D.basis: 606 district (layer 9); ADU Zone 10 (layer 17); ARO CPA; TOD (CTA)

F.answer: Allowed with limits: ADU Zone 10 -> (1) annual limit, (2) owner occupancy (17-7-0573/-0574)

parcels.use_question: Is residential use allowed on this parcel?
parcels.task_question: What is the zoning here, and has it changed recently?

B.answer: Yes: RT-4 permits two-flat, townhouse and multi-unit residential (17-2-0207)
